newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Tuesday as many dealers keyed off a strong Kansas millfeed market.
The strength in the Kansas City market was firming Nebraska, Missouri and Iowa, a St Louis dealer said.
Kansas City is underpinning the other markets due to cold weather, reduced flour mill times and reseller demand, dealers said.
Slower flour mill run times were reported in Kansas and Oklahoma, another dealer said. Demand is coming from the resellers or jobbers, he added.
"It's cold and there is snow, and so that sparks demand," a Kansas broker said.
